text: We evaluated early stopping on weak-label validation loss on the sciq testbed across num_seeds = 3 seeds, obtaining a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.02. This value indicates that the method recovered almost none of the gap between the weak supervisor and the strong ceiling on this testbed, so the procedure as configured does not appear to extract much additional capability from the strong student beyond its weak labels. Two caveats should temper any reading of this number. First, with only three seeds and no reported standard error or variance, the precision of the 0.02 estimate is unknown, and we cannot characterize how much it would move under reseeding. Second, no baseline PGR was supplied for comparison, so we make no claim that this configuration improves on or underperforms any alternative. A larger seed count, reported dispersion, and a matched baseline would be needed before drawing firm conclusions about early stopping on weak-label validation loss.
